notes.title: Woodsalt is Live!
notes.notes:
Woodsalt is finally released! Our little visual novel adventure game has hit the store shelves. It's been a long time coming, but the game is finally here. In the future we'll be releasing additional content as free updates and soon releasing news on our next title in the series. Thank you all so much for all of your support, and if you want to hang out, come join us in the official discord here - https://discord.gg/DGKyNSa
